summary: Separate the Turoyo, English translation and reference
before: omər: “lebayxu-yo! ono lə=g-maṣiṯutu aʕli, kt=owat-lxu kewo d-rišo! ‘He said:
after: omər: “lebayxu-yo! ono lə=g-maṣiṯutu aʕli, kt=owat-lxu kewo d-rišo!”

data.translation: He said: “As you will! If you do not want to listen to me, you will get a headache!”

rationale: The turoyo field ends with the English fragment ‘He said:, the translation starts after that fragment, and 73/36; is stranded at the end of the translation while refs is empty. Restore those three fields together. The allowed corpus at 73/36 independently confirms the speech and reference. This proposal only repairs the field boundaries and quotation delimiters.

summary: Correct the German typo einene → einen
rationale: The German accusative is einen Stoss. The supplied translation of 48/77 also reads einen Stoß; the existing ss spelling is retained.
Reisegeld is neuter, so the nominative possessive is mein. The supplied translation of 66/106 reads mein Reisegeld.
